name: Stonks
author: Gaurav Chande
description: A stock watchlist for your bar. A pixel bull marks an up day and a bear a down day, and both sleep while the market is closed. Point at the chart to see the price at any moment. You also get overnight prices for US stocks and a screenshot sized to post on X. Stocks, ETFs, indexes, and crypto from around the world, each in its own currency. Prices come from Yahoo Finance and Robinhood, with no account or API key.

barWidget.description: Today's move for your stocks, with a chart a click away.

schema.label: Pill
schema.description: How the pill looks in the center or left section of a top or bottom bar. Middle-click the pill to change it.

schema.label: Pill on the right
schema.description: How the pill looks in the right section of a top or bottom bar, among the bar's icons. Middle-click the pill there to change it.

schema.label: Pill on a side bar
schema.description: How the pill looks on a bar at the side of the screen: the day's bull or bear, or the symbol over its change. Middle-click the pill there to switch.
